headline: Jean Houston, ‘Midwife of Souls’ Who Advised Hillary Clinton, Dies at 89
context: The author of books like “The Possible Human,” she held workshops that drew on mythology, psychology and the experiential ethos of Esalen. But she refused to be called a guru.
